name: frpm
definition: 一种信息记录，属加种差：它是按学年记录某所学校学生规模与免费或减价餐资格人数的统计信息条目，区别于学校基本登记信息与考试成绩统计。 Counterexample: 与 satscores 的辨析：两者都按学校统计，但 frpm 记录的是餐费资格与经济弱势相关计数，satscores 记录的是考试参考人数与平均分。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table frpm; provenance: direct source frpm
aliases: 免费及减价餐资格统计记录

name: satscores
definition: 一种信息记录，属加种差：它是按学校汇总的标准化考试成绩统计条目，包含参考人数与各科平均分，区别于学校登记信息与餐费资格统计。 Counterexample: 与 frpm 的辨析：satscores 度量学业考试成绩，frpm 度量免费/减价餐资格人数，二者统计口径不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table satscores; provenance: direct source satscores

name: schools
definition: 一种教育机构，属加种差：它是由教育主管部门登记、具有唯一学校编码与地址、可开设年级并招生的办学单位，区别于其统计记录与成绩记录。 Counterexample: 与 frpm、satscores 的辨析：schools 描述学校实体本身，后两者是依附于学校的统计信息记录，不是学校实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table schools; provenance: direct source schools

name: CharterSchoolFlag
definition: Whether a school is a charter school, recorded as Y/N in frpm and as a code in schools.

name: FreeMealEligiblePercent
definition: Share of K-12 students eligible for free meals.

name: FRPMCount
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: FRPMRate
definition: Share of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate
free or reduced price meal rate

name: EnrollmentK12
definition: Number of students enrolled in grades K-12.

name: EnrollmentAges517
definition: Number of students aged 5-17 enrolled.

name: VirtualSchoolFlag
definition: Whether a school is exclusively virtual (no physical building).

name: DistrictOwnershipCode
definition: District ownership/organization code (DOC) classifying the district type.

name: SchoolPhone
definition: School contact phone number.

name: StreetAddress
definition: School street or mailing address.

name: AvgScrRead
definition: Average SAT reading score for the school.

name: AvgScrMath
definition: Average SAT math score for the school.

name: AvgScrWrite
definition: Average SAT writing score for the school.

name: OpenDate
definition: Date the school opened.

name: ClosedDate
definition: Date the school closed.

name: CountyName
definition: County where the school is located.

name: DistrictName
definition: Name of the school district.

name: SchoolName
definition: Name of the school.

name: EnrollmentDiff
definition: Difference between K-12 enrollment and ages 5-17 enrollment. Formula: EnrollmentK12 - EnrollmentAges517. Inputs: EnrollmentK12 = frpm.Enrollment (K-12); EnrollmentAges517 = frpm.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)

name: AvgMathScore
definition: Average SAT math score across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrMath). Inputs: AvgScrMath = satscores.AvgScrMath

name: AvgReadScore
definition: Average SAT reading score across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrRead). Inputs: AvgScrRead = satscores.AvgScrRead

name: AvgWriteScore
definition: Average SAT writing score across schools. Formula: AVG(AvgScrWrite). Inputs: AvgScrWrite = satscores.AvgScrWrite

name: CharterRatio
definition: Share of schools that are charter schools. Formula: SUM(CharterSchoolFlag) / COUNT(SchoolName). Inputs: CharterSchoolFlag = frpm.Charter School (Y/N); SchoolName = frpm.School Name

name: VirtualSchoolCount
definition: Count of schools that are exclusively virtual. Formula: COUNT(SchoolName) WHERE VirtualSchoolFlag = 'F'. Inputs: VirtualSchoolFlag = schools.Virtual WHERE Virtual = 'F'; SchoolName = frpm.School Name

name: UnifiedToElementaryRatio
definition: Ratio of unified school district schools to elementary school district schools. Formula: COUNT(SchoolName WHERE DistrictOwnershipCode = '54') / COUNT(SchoolName WHERE DistrictOwnershipCode = '52'). Inputs: DistrictOwnershipCode = schools.DOC; SchoolName = frpm.School Name
aliases: ratio of unified to elementary districts

name: Top5FRPMRate
definition: FRPM rate for the top 5 schools by FRPM count. Formula: FRPMRate for schools ranked by FRPMCount DESC LIMIT 5. Inputs: FRPMRate = frpm.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12); FRPMCount = frpm.FRPM Count (K-12)

name: Top5ReadScore
definition: Reading score for the top 5 schools by average reading score. Formula: AvgScrRead for schools ranked by AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 5. Inputs: AvgScrRead = satscores.AvgScrRead

name: Top7MathScore
definition: Math score for the school ranked 7th by average math score. Formula: AvgScrMath for school ranked 7th by AvgScrMath DESC. Inputs: AvgScrMath = satscores.AvgScrMath

name: LowestReadScore
definition: Reading score for the school with the lowest average reading score. Formula: MIN(AvgScrRead). Inputs: AvgScrRead = satscores.AvgScrRead

name: SchoolsWithMathAbove400
definition: Schools whose average math score exceeds 400. Formula: COUNT(SchoolName) WHERE AvgScrMath > 400. Inputs: AvgScrMath = satscores.AvgScrMath; SchoolName = frpm.School Name

name: SchoolsOpenedOrClosed
definition: Schools that opened after 1991 or closed before 2000. Formula: COUNT(SchoolName) WHERE OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'. Inputs: OpenDate = schools.OpenDate WHERE OpenDate > '1991-12-31'; ClosedDate = schools.ClosedDate WHERE ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'; SchoolName = frpm.School Name
aliases: schools opened after 1991 or closed before 2000

name: VirtualSchool
definition: Analyze virtual vs physical schools.

name: DistrictOwnership
definition: Analyze district ownership types.

name: County
definition: Analyze schools by county.
